purpose: Choose the ecological time index for Antarctic penguin trend modeling before count magnitudes are analyzed.

source.frozen_gate0_cohort: 152 Pygoscelis site x species units selected using observation availability only

competing_time_fields.season: APBP breeding-season label; austral-summer observations can belong to the season beginning in the previous calendar year

decision_rule.rule: Use APBP season as the primary demographic time index if season is non-missing for at least 95% of nest-count records belonging to the frozen 152-unit cohort. Otherwise retain calendar year.
decision_rule.rationale: Breeding season is the biologically coherent annual unit for Antarctic penguin reproduction; the threshold prevents excessive time-axis missingness.

audits: fraction of candidate nest-count records with non-missing season
fraction and month distribution of records with year != season
recompute fixed candidate-window eligibility using season within the same frozen Gate0 cohort
compare selected common window and bridged-unit counts to the previous calendar-year audit
window_selection_rule: On the chosen time axis, select the longest candidate window for which each Pygoscelis species retains at least 50% of its frozen Gate0 units under the bridged criterion.
boundary: Count values are not summarized or modeled.
The frozen 152-unit Gate0 cohort is not expanded using season.
Breeding-option predictor definitions are not changed.
Once selected here, the primary time index cannot be changed after demographic outcomes are opened.
